flows.title: Thorough parallel research

flows.title: Cross-layer implementation

defaultStimulus.text: Replace the toy scenario catalog with realistic long-running workflows, preserve the native evidence boundary, add regression coverage, and verify the final diff.

flows.title: Competing-hypotheses incident
flows.summary: Two investigators test deploy and dependency hypotheses using MCP logs/metrics, shell reproduction, and web status evidence; one tool fails, context reaches 93%, compaction preserves the timeline, and a final check isolates the root cause.

defaultStimulus.text: Investigate the API timeout spike. Run competing hypotheses in parallel, identify the root cause from logs and metrics, and recommend the safest immediate mitigation.
